description.value: The Bridge Bistro is an independently owned, casual European-style restaurant perched on the bank of the Elk River in Fernie, BC, beside the West Fernie Bridge with views of the Lizard Range and Fernie Alpine Resort. The kitchen cooks from scratch daily, sourcing produce locally from Broxburn Farm where possible, and their Moroccan-spiced confit duck wings took home 'Best Bite' at Fernie Feast 2025. In warm weather, large overhead doors open onto a riverside patio — a welcome stop after a ride through the Elk Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides the primary evidence. Address (301 Highway #3, Fernie), phone ((250) 423-3002), and takeout availability are explicitly stated on the site. Vegetarian/GF options are confirmed via allergen key (V-Vegetarian, GF-Gluten Free) on both menu pages and the about page. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, device charging, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
